headline.en: New papers on audio effect control, spatial audio, and a piano dataset
headline.zh: 本周新增：音效控制、空间音频与钢琴数据集

summary.en: This week adds five papers and two linked project pages. The additions cover editable audio-effect parameters inferred from a reference, personalised vocal effect recommendations, 6DoF Ambisonic rendering, a large aligned piano dataset, and plan-based spatial audio generation.
summary.zh: 本周新增五篇论文和两个关联项目页面，内容涉及从参考音频推断可编辑音效参数、人声效果个性化推荐、6DoF Ambisonic渲染、大型对齐钢琴数据集，以及基于可执行计划的空间音频生成。

note.en: TAPE infers editable parameters for an explicit differentiable EQ, compression, waveshaping, residual and reverb chain from a processed reference and applies them to a different recording in one forward pass.
note.zh: TAPE从处理后参考音频推断可微均衡、压缩、波形整形、残差与混响链的可编辑参数，并一次前向传播应用于另一段录音。

note.en: A lightweight graph neural network refines array-interpolation weights for wide-area 6DoF Ambisonic rendering, with an analytical DirAC layer reconstructing energy, diffuseness and direction of arrival.
note.zh: 轻量图神经网络细化阵列插值权重以实现广域6DoF Ambisonic渲染，解析DirAC层重建能量、扩散度和到达方向。

note.en: AMBIT uses executable ScenePlans to specify source content, activity and 3D trajectories, coupling autoregressive planning with rectified-flow rendering for native first-order Ambisonic generation and instruction-guided editing.
note.zh: AMBIT通过可执行ScenePlan指定声源内容、活动与三维轨迹，将自回归规划与整流流渲染结合，实现原生一阶Ambisonics生成和指令引导编辑。
